column1: # One experiment per result of the paper (Rasoamanana, Levillain, Debar, ESORICS 2022).
# "expect:" gives what the paper reports; docs/reproducing-the-paper.md explains how to check it.
# kind  image  tls_version  scenario  [extra pylstar-tls arguments]
# --- E3 (Sec. 7.1, Fig. 4): server authentication bypasses in wolfSSL TLS 1.3 clients ----------
# expect: v4.4.0 accepts SH, EE, Cert, Fin (no CertificateVerify) -> Fin+AppData (CVE-2020-24613)
# expect: v4.5.0 no longer accepts a missing CV, but EmptyCert + CV signed by any key works (CVE-2021-3336)
# expect: v5.1.0 EmptyCert + invalid CV (unknown signature algorithm) -> AppData (CVE-2022-25638)
# expect: v5.2.0 fixed: no path to AppData without Cert + valid CV
# Same with curl linked against wolfSSL (the paper checked both to confirm the bypasses)
# --- E4 (Sec. 7.1, Fig. 5): client authentication bypass in wolfSSL TLS 1.3 servers -------------
# expect: CH, [Cert,] Fin (no CertificateVerify) -> AppData up to 5.1.x (CVE-2022-25640); fixed in 5.2.0
# --- E5 (Sec. 7.1): OpenSSL s_client "bypasses" are false positives ------------------------------
# expect: s_client paths accept any certificate; they disappear with curl+OpenSSL
# --- E6 (Sec. 7.2, Table 2, App. B.1): loops before encryption (DoS) ----------------------------
# expect: Erlang 24 server loops on NoRenegotiation / ApplicationData (TLS 1.0/1.2)
# expect: fizz 2021 TLS 1.3 clients loop on ChangeCipherSpec
# expect: NSS 3.15-3.78 TLS 1.0/1.2 servers loop on the NoRenegotiation alert
# expect: OpenSSL < 1.1.0 TLS 1.0/1.2 servers loop on empty ApplicationData; 1.1.1k does not
# expect: wolfSSL <= 4.4.0 TLS 1.2 server DoS (CVE-2020-12457); fixed in 4.5.0
# expect: wolfSSL TLS 1.2 server NoRenegotiation loop on the initial state = FALSE POSITIVE
#         (the server really closes after 4 warnings; confirm with replay mode)
# (MatrixSSL 4.0-4.3, CVE-2022-25639, cannot be reproduced: the MatrixSSL 4.x sources are gone)
# expect: several wolfSSL servers accept Certificate/CertificateVerify that they never requested
# --- E8 (App. B.2): EarlyCCS (CVE-2014-0224) and FREAK (CVE-2015-0204) in OpenSSL ----------------
# expect: unexpected early ChangeCipherSpec transitions up to 0.9.8za / 1.0.0l / 1.0.1h, gone after
# expect: clients accept an RSA EXPORT ServerHello up to 0.9.8zc / 1.0.0o / 1.0.1j, not after
# --- E9 (App. B.3): Bleichenbacher padding oracles (bb-oracle scenario) ---------------------------
# expect: well-formed and malformed ClientKeyExchange distinguishable (ROBOT) in wolfSSL <= 3.12.2
# --- E10 (Sec. 8.1, Table 3): TLS 1.3 server fingerprinting, one version per class ---------------
# expect (states): Erlang 24 = 9, GnuTLS = 4, NSS 3.39-3.40 = 4, NSS 3.41-3.78 = 4, OpenSSL 1.1.1 = 4,
#   (13 classes in the paper, 11 here without MatrixSSL 4.x; 8 sequences separate them)
